tei:div.tei:p: "$ (123)༄༅// rten 'brel gyi sgom rim dam pa'i chos kyi za ma tog bzhugs so//

(124)༄༅// gang gis chos kun gzigs pa'i lam// yangs par 'gro ba ma lus pa// 'dren mdzad bka' brgyud bla ma la// dang ba rgya mtshos phyag bgyi'o// chos thams cad ni rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba las gzhan ma yin la/ de gtan la 'bebs pa'i gdams ngag /rabs bdun ma'i sgom pa'i rim pa ni rnam pa gnyis te/ mnyam gzhag yon tan skye ba'i rten 'brel dang*/ rjes thob rtsal rdzogs pa'i rten 'brel lo// dang po ni/ bsam gtan gyi tsher ma rnam par g.yeng bas dben pa'i gnas nyams dgyes shing yid du mchis par tshe 'di'i 'dod pa dang*/ zhen pa dang*/ sred pa 'phel ba'i rten bskyungs te/ sgrib pa lnga dang mi dge ba bcu'i chom rkun dang bral bas/ bde ba'i stan la rkang pa rdo rje skyil mo krung dang*/ lag pa mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya lte 'og tu bcings/ sgal tshigs drang por bsrangs/ dpung pa phan tshun phyir deng*/ mgrin pa og skos mdun non tsam/ lce mchu rang sar bzhag /mig sna rtse'i thad du lta ba byed chings dang ldan pas rlung ro lan gcig bus te/ dbugs 'byung rngub kyi rtsol ba med (125)par rang babs su bzhag nas/ thog ma nyid du sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par bya/ de'i ched du rnal 'byor zab mo la 'jug par bya'o snyam pas/ rin po che'i khri/ pad zla'i gdan la rang nyid rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa sku gser btso ma lta bu/ mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis dang dpe byad brgyad cus shin tu mdzes pa/ phyag gnyis sa gnon mnyam bzhag mtshams sprin gzhon nu'i 'od ltar dmar ba'i chos gos gsum 'chang ba/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs par gsal ba'i spyi bo'i nam mkhar/ rtsa ba'i bla ma bsgom ste/ snang ba rten 'brel du 'char bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ ces gdung shugs drag pos gsol ba btab ste/ rang gi mdun gnya' shing gang tsam gyi thad du/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor shin tu dwangs shing 'od zer gyi 'khor lo can la mig dang sems rtse gcig tu gtad de/

sngar 'di byas/ 'di las/ 'di 'byung ngo la sogs pa 'das pa min no/ da 'di byed 'di las 'di 'byung ngam mi 'byung sogs ma 'ongs pa mi sem/ da ltar ji ltar snang ba'i tshogs (126)'di bzang 'ding na/ 'di yin 'di min snyam du bsam pa dang*/ rig pas dpyad par mi bya/ ched du 'di lta bu'o zhes kyang mi bsgom/ stong pa'o zhes cang med ci med kyi chad lta yug tu'ang mi blta/ blos byas kyi stong pa nyid dang*/ ye shes yin no snyam pa'i rgyas 'debs dang don spyi yang mi bsgom/ 'o na ji ltar zhes shes pa cir yang mi rtog /cir yang mi 'dzin/ dran pa dang yid la byed pa thams cad spangs te/ ma yengs tsam gyis sems lhug pa ma bcos pa nyid la rtse gcig tu mnyam par 'jog par bya'o// de ltar yang*/ 'gro ba'i mgon po gtsang pas/ sems ma bcos na bde/ chu ma rnyog na dwangs/ zhes dang*/ gling gis/ ma bcos so mar bzhag na rtogs pa 'char/ chu bo'i gzhung bzhin bskyangs na yongs kyang 'char/ dmigs gtad mtshan ma thams cad yongs spongs la/ rtag tu mnyam par zhog dang rnal 'byor ba/ zhes dang*/ bde gshegs khams pa chen pos/ phyag chen ngo sprod du/ bsgom bya sgom byed du byas na blo bcos ma'o// 'o na ji ltar zhe na/ rang gsal rnam rtog ngag chags gang byung ma bcos par gzhag na rang mthong bar 'gyur ro// zhes dang*/ sa ra has/ bsam dang bsam bya thams cad yongs su dor nas su/ ji ltar bu chung lhug par gnas pa bzhin/ bla ma'i lung la bsgrims te gus 'bad na/ lhan cig skyes pa 'byung bar the tshom med/ ces dang*/ byams mgon gyis/ 'di la bsal bya ci yang med// bzhag bar bya ba cung zad med// yang dag nyid la yang dag lha// yang dag mthong na yang dag gol/ zhes gsungs/ sher phyin gyi mdor yang*/ phung 'di stong zhes rtog na'ang byang chub sems dpa' rnams// mtshan ma la spyod skye med gnas la dad ma yin/ zhes dang*/ brtag gnyis las/ gang phyir yid kyis mi bsgom par// 'gro ba thams (127)cad bsgom par bya// zhes gsungs/

'di la kha cig na re/ dam pa sangs rgyas kyis/ stong nyid mkha' la rig pa'i mdud skor gyis/ lta ba thogs rdugs med do ding ri ba/ zhes gsungs pas ma dpyad pa'i sgom pa ni/ blun sgom yin gyi/ lhag mthong gi rtogs pa mi 'byung ngo zer mod/ lung des ni kho bo cag la gnod pa ma yin te/ lung 'di'i don 'chad pa la zhugs na/ cir snang ba'i cha nas snang ba dang*/ de nyid gang du grub par btsal bas ma rnyed pa stong pa dang*/ de 'tshol mkhan de la rig pa zer ba yin gyi /thos bsam gyis gtan la phab pa'i rig pa dang don mi gcig /'di skabs kyi rig pa de gnas cha ma yengs pa'i steng nas byung tshor thams cad shes shing*/ shes pa'i mod la rang sar grol bar byed pas rig pa'i mdung skor gyis zer ba yin la/ de'i tshe shes bya dang shes mkhan gyi rig pa gnyis tha dad du grub pa rtsa ba nas ma yin pas dbyer med dang*/ lta byed kyi rig pa'ang ngo bo ngos gzung gang du'ang ma grub pas/ rig stong zung 'jug gi rnam gzhag byed pa yin no// de ltar ha cang dran shes kyis grims ches na rtog pa'i 'phro rkyen byed la/ glod thal na 'khrul pa la 'byams mchi bas/ yid kyi glang po rtse gcig pa'i ka ba la ma yengs pa'i thag pas gdags par bya'o// de ltar bsgoms pas/ 'khor 'das gang la yang ma reg pa/ rten med ngos gzung spros pa thams cad dang bral ba/ sus kyang tshig gis ston par mi nus rang gis myong bya'am rig byar gyur/ mthong rgyu gsar du med la/ mthong ba'i mchog bcos ma min pa zhig nang nas 'char te/ 'di ni sgom tha mal gyi shes pa ngo 'phrod pa yin te/ slob dpon tog rtse pas/ tha mal shes pa snying gi dbus su sad/ ces dang*/ jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti shas/ rtogs med tshul gyis rtogs pas na/ stong nyid mthong (128)zhes tha snyad gdags// ma mthong ba nyid de mthong bar// shin tu zab mo'i mdo las gsungs// de la mthong dang mthong byed med// thog ma tha ma med zhi ba// dngos dang dngos med rnam par spangs// rnam par rtog med dmigs pa bral// gnas pa me dang gnas med pa// 'gro 'ong med cing dpe dang bral// brjod du med pa bltar med pa// 'gyur ba med pa 'dus ma byas// rnal 'byor pa yis de rtogs na// nyon mongs shes bya'i sgrib pa spong*/

zhes gsungs/ gnyis pa rjes thob rtsal rdzogs pa'i rten 'brel ni/ de ltar bsgoms pa'i tshe/ sems mi gnas par 'phro na/ de nyid kyi steng du ngos btsir gyis gzung la bzo bcos med par glod pas rang sar grol bar 'gyur ba chu la chu bzhag pa bzhin no// de bzhin du nyon mongs pa chags sdang rmongs pa shugs shin tu drag pa la yang spang bar mi bya/ dbang du yang mi gtong*/ gnyen pos kyang mi gzhom par/ gang skyes de nyid ngos bzung nas de thog tu glod na de nyid stong par zang thal le 'char te/ 'gro mgon rin po che phag mo gru pas/ rnam rtog byung yang 'jigs par mi bya ste/ dran pa'i dus nyid na gnyug ma'i ngo bor grub pa'i phyir ro// zhes dang*/ yang gnyug ma'i ngo bo la rnam rtog byung yang*/ nam langs pa'i mun pa bzhin rang bzhin gyis dengs par 'gyur ro// rje btsun mi las/ sems nyid bsgom du bde lags na// rnam rtog sems kyi cho 'phrul yin// da rung cho 'phrul gtan la phob/ ces dang*/ sa ra has/ ji srid sems las rnam 'phros pa// de srid mgon po'i rang bzhin te// chu dang rlabs dag gzhan yin nam/ zhes dang*/ rnam snang mngon byang las/ mi rtog ting 'dzin la gnas na// nam mkha' bzhin du rtog med gsal/ zhes dang*/ sam+bu ṭar/ rnam rtog nyid kyis rnam rtog sbyang*/ zhes gsungs pas so// de bzhin du lam khyer de nyid kyis tshogs drug gi snang ba thams (129)cad la/ dang por snang mkhan gyi shes pa ngos bzung nas/ de thog tu rtsal sbyang*/ de la goms nas snang thog tu bzhag pas/ snang ba shar ba dang grol ba dus mnyam du byung bas snang sems 'dres pa zhes ngo mtshar can cig 'byung ba yin no// dus de'i tshe lam gang shar la spang blang med pa gsha' ma de 'byung ba yin te/ sa ra has/ mdun dang rgyab dang phyogs bcu ru// gang ltar mthong ba de de nyid// de ring mgon bong ltar 'khrul pa chad// da ni su la'ang dri bar mi bya'o// zhes dang*// rtogs par gyur na thams cad de yin te// de las gzhan zhig sus kyang rnyed mi 'gyur// klog pa de yin 'dzin dang bsgom pa'ang de// bstan bcos snying la 'chad pa'ang de yin no// zhes gsungs/

de tsa na/ 'khor ba dang myang 'das/ rnam rtog dang chos sku/ nyon mongs dang ye shes thams cad rgyal khams gcig tu song ba yin no// gang gi tshe ldang bar 'dod na dal bus ldang ste/ sgyu ma lta bu'i blos/ lus ngag yid kyi dge ba ci nus bya'o// stong nyid de yang snying rjes ma zin na sangs rgyas kyi lam du mi 'gyur bas/ byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems bsgom par bya ste/ sgyu ma lta bu'i blos/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang ldan na snyam du bsgom/ bde ba ni rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa yin la/ de thob pa la rgyu zag pa dang zag pa med pa'i dge ba'i rtsa bsgrub pa dang ldan na snyam pa'i byams pa yid dang 'dre nges par bsgom/ de bzhin du sdug bsngal te khams gsum 'khor ba'i gnas skabs dang bral na snyam du bsgom/ de dang bral ba la de'i rgyu las dang nyon mongs pa'i kun 'byung gnyis dang bral na snyam pa'i snying rje bsgom/ de nas/ rang gi sna g.yas nas 'od zer 'phros/ sems can thams cad kyi sna g.yas nas zhugs/ de thams cad kyi sdug bsngal thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam par tshur byung*/ rang gi sna bug g.yas nas tshur zhugs/ sems (130)can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal bdag la smin/ sems can thams cad sdug bsngal dang bral bar bsam/ de nas rang gi bde ba sna g.yon nas 'od zer gyi rnam par 'thon/ sems can thams cad la byin pas de thams cad bde ba dang ldan par bsam/ sems can gyi sdug bsngal bdag la smin pa de thog tu gzhag pas zag pa med pa'i bde ba chen por gyur par bsam/ de la 'byongs na dngos su'ang bdag gzhan brje ba'i byang chub kyi sems la bslab bo/ de ltar bsgoms pa'i rjes thog tu bdag gis 'di ltar bsgoms pa dang*/ dus gsum du bsags pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba ci mchis pa de'i mthus bdag dang sems can thams cad sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho las bsgral te/ rnam mkhyen sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par gyur cig snyam du bsams te 'phags pa byams pa dang kun tu bzang po la sogs pa'i smon lam la 'jug par bya'o// de ltar rten 'brel gyi sgom pa'i rim pa'i man ngag dam pa'i chos kyi zam tog ces bya ba 'di ni/

sde srid rin po che phag mo gru pa dpal gong ma chen po'i thugs dam du/ bka' brgyud kyi btsun pa pad+ma dkar pos sbyar ba 'dis kyang rgyal ba'i bstan pa dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas par gyur cig /sarba maṅga laṃ/// /
